title: 공항과 기내
description: 탑승 수속, 게이트, 기내에서 쓰는 말

expressions.en: I'd like an aisle seat, please.
Can I take this bag on the plane?
expressions.ko: 이 가방 기내에 가지고 타도 돼요?

expressions.en: Which gate do I need to go to?
Could I get a blanket, please?
Chicken, please.
expressions.tip: 기내식을 고를 때는 메뉴 이름에 please만 붙여도 충분해요.

expressions.en: I'm here on vacation.
expressions.tip: 입국 심사에서 방문 목적을 물을 때 써요.

dialogue.setting: 공항 체크인 카운터에서 탑승 수속을 해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Here you go.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Thank you. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 창가와 통로 자리 중 어디로 드릴까요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'd like an aisle seat, please.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure. Do you have any bags to check?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Just one. Can I take this bag on the plane?
lines.ko: 하나요. 이 가방은 기내에 가지고 타도 돼요?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Yes, that's fine. Here's your boarding pass.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thank you. Which gate do I need to go to?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 몇 번 게이트로 가야 해요?

aiScenario.role: an airline check-in agent at the airport
aiScenario.situation: Check the learner in for an international flight: ask for the passport, seat preference, and checked bags, then give gate and boarding information.
aiScenario.opening: Good morning! Where are you flying to today?

expressions.en: I'd like to check in, please.
expressions.tip: I'd like to는 I want to보다 공손해요.

expressions.en: I have a reservation under Kim.
What time is breakfast?
Could I get a late checkout?
What's the Wi-Fi password?
Could you send up some extra towels?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good evening! Welcome to the Grand Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 그랜드 호텔에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Hi, I'd like to check in, please.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, I have a reservation under Kim.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Here it is. Two nights in a double room.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That's right. What time is breakfast?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: From seven to ten on the second floor.
lines.ko: 이 층에서 일곱 시부터 열 시까지입니다.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Great. Could I get a late checkout?

aiScenario.role: a friendly front desk clerk at a hotel
aiScenario.situation: The learner is checking in. Ask for the reservation name, confirm the stay, and handle one simple request such as a late checkout or extra towels.
aiScenario.opening: Good evening! Welcome to the Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요! 그랜드 호텔에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 예약하셨나요?

expressions.en: A table for two, please.
Could we see the menu, please?
What do you recommend?
expressions.tip: 직원에게 추천 메뉴를 물을 때 써요.

expressions.en: I'll have the steak, medium, please.
Could I get some more water?
Can we have the check, please?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good evening. How many people?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: A table for two, please.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Right this way. Here's your table.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thank you. What do you recommend?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Our steak is very popular tonight.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Then I'll have the steak, medium, please.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Excellent choice. Anything to drink?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Just water, please.

aiScenario.role: a waiter at a casual restaurant
aiScenario.situation: Seat the learner, take their order, answer questions about the menu, and bring the check at the end.
aiScenario.opening: Good evening and welcome! How many people are in your party?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요, 어서 오세요! 일행이 몇 분이세요?

expressions.en: Could you take me to this address?
How much is the fare to downtown?
Does this bus go to the museum?
Where should I get off?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Please stop here.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi! Where are you going?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Could you take me to this address?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure. That's the Grand Hotel, right?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes. How long will it take?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: About twenty minutes if there's no traffic.
lines.ko: 차가 안 막히면 이십 분 정도요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Okay. Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Of course. Here we are.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Please stop here. Thank you!

aiScenario.role: a taxi driver in a big city
aiScenario.situation: The learner gets in your taxi. Ask where they are going, chat a little about the city and the traffic, and handle payment when you arrive.
aiScenario.opening: Hi there! Where can I take you today?

expressions.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
expressions.tip: 점원이 도와줄까 물을 때 부담 없이 거절하는 말이에요.

expressions.en: Do you have this in a medium?
Can I try this on?
It's a little too tight.
I'd like to return this, please.
Here's my receipt.

dialogue.setting: 옷 가게에서 산 셔츠를 바꾸러 왔어요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi there! Can I help you find anything?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes. I bought this shirt yesterday, but it's a little too tight.
lines.ko: 네. 어제 이 셔츠를 샀는데 조금 너무 껴요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like a bigger size?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Do you have this in a medium?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Let me check. Sorry, we're out of mediums.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 죄송하지만 미디엄은 다 팔렸어요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Then I'd like to return this, please. Here's my receipt.
lines.ko: 그럼 이거 반품하고 싶어요. 영수증 여기 있어요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: No problem. I'll refund it to your card.

aiScenario.role: a sales clerk at a clothing store
aiScenario.situation: Help the learner find the right size, let them try things on, and handle an exchange or a refund politely.
aiScenario.opening: Hi there! Welcome in. Are you looking for anything special today?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요! 어서 오세요. 오늘 특별히 찾는 거 있으세요?

title: 곤란한 상황 해결하기
description: 물건을 잃어버리거나 아플 때 도움 청하기

expressions.en: I lost my wallet.
I think I left it on the bus.
Could you help me, please?
I don't feel well.
Is there a pharmacy nearby?
Where is the nearest police station?

dialogue.setting: 여행 중 지갑을 잃어버려 호텔 직원에게 도움을 청해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hello. You look worried. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Not really. I lost my wallet.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Oh no. Do you remember where you last had it?
lines.ko: 저런. 마지막으로 어디서 가지고 계셨는지 기억나세요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I think I left it on the bus.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I can call the bus company for you.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thank you. Where is the nearest police station?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: It's just two blocks away. I'll draw you a map.
lines.ko: 두 블록만 가면 있어요. 지도를 그려 드릴게요.

aiScenario.situation: The learner has a problem during their trip, such as a lost item or feeling sick. Ask questions, show concern, and suggest practical next steps.
aiScenario.opening: Hello. You look a little worried. Is everything okay?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요. 조금 걱정이 있어 보이시네요. 괜찮으세요?
